name: swallow_english_mt_bench
description: A machine-translation benchmarking dataset focused on English (likely for evaluating translation to/from English). It measures translation quality of models across provided language pairs and domains, emphasizing automatic MT metrics and model comparison for English-centric translation tasks. Intended to assess LLM/MT systems' fidelity and fluency in English translation outputs.
evaluation_method: BLEU (and other MT metrics such as chrF / BLEURT where applicable)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset with modest usage; primarily used by researchers and practitioners evaluating English-centered MT models.
